$comment: For every jurisdiction the source watch covers: what auto-update can correct by itself ('automatic', each backed by a rule in autoupdate.json), what it only compares and reports ('report_only'), and what is left to a person and why. tests enforce that every income-tax or local-tax jurisdiction in data/ appears here and that every reference is real. 'No wage income tax and no local tax' jurisdictions (AK FL NH NV SD TN TX WY) are in scope.json's excluded list instead.

person.why: Withholding comes from per-period tables or bracket schedules that the agency publishes as PDF or HTML tables. A cell in such a table cannot be verified one line at a time (the extractions are prone to column shifts), so a change is reported and a person updates the table.

person.what: 29 municipal occupational taxes and Jefferson County
person.why: The League of Municipalities' list (compared city by city every day) is a survey with no effective dates and covers 25 of the 29 cities, and 21 of the data's entries were confirmed from the city's own documents, so a difference is reported for a person to check with the city, never applied. Entries carry dated rateHistory rows. The data carries dated rows or overlays (rates that differ before and after a mid-year date). Adding or changing a dated row is a structural edit, which auto-update never makes.
